apocalyptic-reincarnation-start-with-a-3:
The end of the world has come, the world order is in chaos, and human morality has declined.
Li Yu, a cold man, was reborn and won a 30-million bonus at the start of his new life. He built a god-level base and hoarded resources.
While others were struggling on the brink of starvation to death, Li Yu was enjoying himself on the rooftop, having a barbecue and drinking beer.
ashes-on-the-highway:
Five years ago, Rowan “Rowe” Callahan was ripped from everything she loved when her father was murdered and her mother vanished. Shipped away by the club’s ruthless president—the man she secretly desired—Rowe built a new life far from the roar of engines and the weight of secrets.
Now she’s back. Her brother is dead, ruled a suicide she refuses to believe. The man who once protected her as his ward, Reaper—cold, deadly, and untouchable—holds dangerous truths behind his steel-gray eyes. Determined to uncover what really happened to her family, Rowe forces her way into the club as a prospect, igniting old flames and deadly new enemies.
As rival clubs close in and traitors bleed from within the Reapers, Rowe and Reaper’s forbidden passion explodes into something raw, possessive, and impossible to deny. But every answer she unearths brings her closer to a devastating truth: the man she’s falling for may be the one who destroyed her family.
In a world where blood ties are lies and the road only leads to ashes, Rowe must decide how far she’ll ride for justice… and whether love is worth the ultimate betrayal.
blood-fur:
A new emperor rules each year in Yohuachanca.
Only the most delicious of food graces his palate; the realm’s most beautiful women fill his harem; his palace dazzles the mind in its beauty; and four priestesses counsel him in all matters. The life of an emperor is good, luxurious, and short.
For at the year’s end, he is sacrificed to the Nightlords under the light of the Scarlet Moon.
I am Iztac. A pisspoor orphan and the year’s emperor. A sacrifice bound for the altar.
But the vampires have made a mistake this time. For I am a sorcerer, whose soul journeys into the secret underworld to plunder the secret spells of the dead. There, in the darkness, hides the power to drag the Nightlords off their throne. I have a year to find it, or perish for good.
I may not be the first emperor, but I will be the last.

brushstrokes-of-revenge:
They chose her over me. My father, my brothers, even my husband—they all chose my stepsister when I needed them most.
Kidnapped, betrayed, and left to die, Mindy Wilson's last memory was falling from a rooftop in the rain. But death wasn't the end.
She woke up eight years in the past, back in the marriage that destroyed her, back when her stepsister Missy was still playing the innocent victim, back when her cold husband Layton Knight had just begun falling for the wrong woman.
This time, Mindy won't beg. She won't cry. She won't be the perfect daughter, the perfect wife, the perfect victim.
This time, she'll expose every lie, reclaim everything stolen from her, and show them all exactly who the real villain is.
They wanted her gone? Too bad. The heiress has returned, and she's done playing nice.

*Dark Mafia Romance*
Pregnant.
“I..” she blinked at the words that were blinding her. “I..”
“I? I? What, Evelyn?” Salvatore spat, making her flinch. “What is it that you want to say, say it loud and fucking clear!”
She jumped on the spot and closed her eyes in fear. “I..”
“What?!” His scream was powerful enough that Evelyn jumped on the spot and started to cry. Why was this happening to her? Why were these papers in front of her?
“I don't know,” she screamed back with rivers of tears flowing down her face. “I don't know what happened. I don't know what's happening!”
Salvatore chuckled darkly and shook his head as he barked out at her, “You don't know what's going on? Fine, I will tell you what's going on. You are three months pregnant with the child of a man that you spent one night with.” His voice lowered several octaves and deepened. He was controlling himself.
The reality made her close her eyes and lower her head.
The product of a one night stand was inside her womb.
This reason alone was enough for her father to discard her had he been alive and he was her father but Salvatore was her husband. She opened her eyes and looked at him again.…

epoch-of-twilight:

Evolution has turned the flora and fauna of the vast and bountiful Earth into something that had never been seen before. Coincidentally, the all-dominating Homo sapiens have ended up at the bottom of the food chain. From mystery to crisis, will Luo Yuan discover a means of saving humanity by racing to the top of the food chain? Or will he strive in accordance with the law of the jungle? gilded-ashes:
“You will suffice.”
Raizen heard those words the night something chose him to survive.
He doesn't know what whispered inside his head. He doesn't know why. But ever since that night, his life hasn't been entirely his own. Something marked him.
Now he walks a beautiful world built on even prettier lies, where Eon turns desperation into miracles, Luminite weapons twist the laws of what's possible and what's not, and where humanity has been fighting creatures of shadow - Nyxes - for as long as anyone can remember. Though sometimes, the cruelest of enemies aren't made of darkness at all...
But Raizen is starting to realize: the monsters aren't the only things hunting him.
Something primordial is watching. Waiting. Pulling strings he can't see.
If he wants to survive, he needs to get stronger.
If he wants answers, he must become someone even the nightmares fear.
...But to win?
He may have to end anything in his path - and pray he doesn't give the whisper exactly what it wanted all along.
